नोति, ऋणद्धि (and in some forms cl. 2,
as pres. 2nd du. ऋधाथे, pot. 1st pl. ऋध्याम,
impf. 1st pl. आर्ध्म), आनर्ध, अर्धिष्यति,
आर्धीत्, अर्धितुम्, to succeed, prosper; to grow,
increase, flourish; to be prosperous and happy, to

make prosperous, cause to succeed; to accomplish;
to gratify, satisfy: Caus. अर्धयति, -यितुम्, to
